name: C10-0071/2025 – Commission proposal
title: Amending Regulation (EU) No 228/2013 as regards additional assistance and further flexibility to outermost regions affected by severe natural disasters and in the context of cyclone Chido devastating Mayotte ***I
part_text:
Belgium asked to change one part of its recovery plan, the EU-funded plan for spending on reforms and investment. One measure on end-of-career and pensions can no longer be finished on time because of circumstances outside Belgium's control. Belgium will now adopt the pension proposal by the Council of Ministers instead of just submitting it. The European Commission accepts this and proposes the change; the money for Belgium stays the same.

- One pension measure gets more time, and its final step now means adoption by Belgium's Council of Ministers.
- It affects Belgium's recovery plan and its pension reform; the total EU money for Belgium does not change.
- The Council of the EU must approve this change before it takes effect.
